component.name: Frameiru
component.summary: Virtual webcam with background blur and replacement

description.p: Frameiru turns your camera into a virtual webcam with background blur, replacement, and stylized overlays. It reads a physical camera, computes a foreground mask with an embedded neural matting model, composites the new background, and publishes the result to a v4l2loopback device that Zoom, Google Meet, Teams, Discord, or any other video app selects as a regular webcam.

ul.li: Backgrounds: passthrough, blur, solid color, image, or looping video, switchable while streaming
Zero-setup segmentation: the matting model ships inside the app, no model download
GPU compositing with automatic CPU fallback, plus live preview and metrics
Overlay effects: scanlines, light leak, CRT, chromatic aberration, VHS tracking, dithering, halftone, grayscale
Webcam controls (brightness, contrast, vendor UVC controls) for supported devices
